name: Reslice ROIs to match input anatomy (with affine)
summary: Moves a set of ROI volumes onto a T1-weighted image's voxel grid by applying an FSL affine transform (optionally inverted) with flirt and nearest-neighbour interpolation, then binarises them.
description: For each ROI NIfTI, flirt -applyxfm applies the affine from the transform input (inverted with convert_xfm when inverse is true) using the T1w image as reference, and fslmaths binarises the result. Use it to bring ROIs defined in another space (for example a template) into subject anatomical space when an FSL-format affine is available; nonlinear warps in the transform input are not used.

inputs.description: T1-weighted image used as the reference grid and target space.
Directory of ROI NIfTI volumes to transform.
Transform datatype; only the FSL-format affine matrix (affine key) is read.
inputs.requirements: The affine must be an FSL (flirt) matrix relating the ROI space and the T1w space.

outputs.description: Binarised ROI volumes in the T1w space and voxel grid.

parameters.description: If true, the affine is inverted with convert_xfm before it is applied (use when the affine maps anatomy to the ROI space).

citations.text: Jenkinson M, Beckmann CF, Behrens TE, Woolrich MW, Smith SM. FSL. NeuroImage 62:782-790 (2012).
